# Referências {.unnumbered}

## TRIGRS — documentação oficial

- Baum, R.L., Savage, W.Z. & Godt, J.W. (2008). *TRIGRS — A Fortran program for transient
  rainfall infiltration and grid-based regional slope-stability analysis, version 2.0*.
  U.S. Geological Survey Open-File Report 2008-1159, 75 p.
- Baum, R.L., Godt, J.W. & Savage, W.Z. (2010). Estimating the timing and location of shallow
  rainfall-induced landslides using a model for transient, unsaturated infiltration.
  *Journal of Geophysical Research*, 115, F03013. doi:10.1029/2009JF001321
- Alvioli, M. & Baum, R.L. (2016). Parallelization of the TRIGRS model for rainfall-induced
  landslides using the message passing interface. *Environmental Modelling & Software*, 81,
  122–135.
- Iverson, R.M. (2000). Landslide triggering by rain infiltration. *Water Resources
  Research*, 36(7), 1897–1910.
- Código-fonte oficial: <https://code.usgs.gov/usgs/landslides-trigrs>

## Aplicações do TRIGRS

- Schwarz, H. & Michel, G.P. (2017). Avaliação de estabilidade de encostas com uso do modelo
  TRIGRS no município de Ibirama-SC. *XXII Simpósio Brasileiro de Recursos Hídricos*, ABRH.
- Konig, T., Kux, H. & Corsi, A. (2022). Landslide risk management using the mathematical
  model TRIGRS. *Geociências (UNESP)*, 41(1), 243–254.
- Bordoni, M., Meisina, C., Valentino, R., Bittelli, M. & Chersich, S. (2015). Site-specific
  to local-scale shallow landslides triggering zones assessment using TRIGRS.
  *Natural Hazards and Earth System Sciences*, 15, 1025–1050.
- Ciurleo, M., Ferlisi, S., Foresta, V., Mandaglio, M.C. & Moraci, N. (2022). Landslide
  susceptibility analysis by applying TRIGRS to a reliable geotechnical slope model.
  *Geosciences*, 12, 18.
